row security on for every created table

settings rows rooms, live, followups present

cutover_findings.finding: origin/codex/supabase-completion-20261004 (1bccb34) is an ancestor of main and lacks 138 commits: the five live-calls migrations, supabase/functions/sales-live, 194 changed sales-api files, the room screens (RoomPanel, RoomLine, RoomsHealth, AvailabilityStrip, VideoLink, WavesCard, SalesBanner) and the deck.
cutover_findings.breaks: An Edge Function deploy from that branch replaces sales-api v65 with pre-live-calls code. scripts/ship.sh accepts 1bccb34 (it is on origin/main) and cannot see it is older because the live /sales bundle carries no VITE_VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA, so the room screens and the deck would vanish.
cutover_findings.keep: Deploy from origin/main at or after e166a0b (tag pre-supabase-migration-2026-10-07).

cutover_findings.finding: 20261004a_cockpit_staff_identity_adoption is not applied in production (cockpit_sales_seat is still the cockpit_sales_people version; cockpit_editor_actor_email, cockpit_editor_request_actor, cockpit_editor_request_audit are missing). It rewrites cockpit_sales_seat/email/manager to need a cockpit_members row linked to auth.uid().
cutover_findings.breaks: 2 of 5 active portal sales people (the closer and the setter) have 'sales' member rows with auth_user_id null. The closer has a confirmed login and is linked by cockpit_adopt_member at the next sign-in; the setter has no auth user. Until linked they fail every seat-gated read: the *_seat_read policies on cockpit_sales_rooms, room_events, room_hosts, availability, live and the five followup tables, plus all browser reads of sales tables. The 3 managers pass.
cutover_findings.keep: Link (or have them sign in through the native app) right after the SQL lands, before any live-call switch goes on.

cutover_findings.finding: supabase_migrations.schema_migrations holds 83 dialer-repo versions only (max 20261006170116); no cockpit migration is recorded, and names like 20261003a_sales_rooms.sql do not match the CLI's <timestamp>_name.sql pattern.
cutover_findings.breaks: Neither db push nor the table can tell what is applied. Re-running older files would revert cockpit_sales_setter_deals (20260927a_sales_setter_pay, replaced by 20261004a_live_calls_hardening_2). Re-running the live-calls files themselves is idempotent (create or replace, drop/create trigger, cron unschedule/schedule, settings seeds on conflict do nothing).
cutover_findings.keep: Apply only the unapplied native files, in order; never replay 20260927a after 20261004a_live_calls_hardening_2.

cutover_findings.finding: Native migrations whose objects are absent in production: 20260926a (1 fn), 20260926k, 20260926l, 20260927b_eod_delivery_claims, 20260927c_cockpit_people_access, 20260927i (creative actions, finance refresh), 20260927r, 20261004a_cockpit_staff_identity_adoption (3 fns), 20261004b (ceo costs, csm providers, team security), 20261004d_team_native_commands, 20261004e_cockpit_ceo_providers, 20261004z_native_monitor, 20261005b_cockpit_ceo_refresh_worker.
cutover_findings.breaks: None of them names a live-calls or guardian table, function, trigger, cron job or vault secret, and none has a blanket grant/revoke or default-privileges change. Only the identity adoption above touches what the rooms use.

cutover_findings.finding: cockpit_sales_settings has guard triggers for insert/update, delete and truncate on keys rooms, live, threads, followups.
cutover_findings.breaks: A data reload that deletes or truncates cockpit_sales_settings is refused with an error, and an upsert that turns a guarded switch on without a manager actor fails. The contract migrations write key 'contracts', which is not guarded.

cutover_findings.finding: There is no supabase/config.toml; functions are deployed through the management API with explicit verify_jwt.
cutover_findings.breaks: A CLI 'supabase functions deploy' defaults verify_jwt to true. sales-live must stay false: pg_cron reaches it through net.http_post with CRON_SECRET, which is not a JWT, so every sweep replay/settle would get 401. sales-mirror, tap-charges-sync, webinar-events and the GHL syncs are also false.

cutover_findings.finding: Function secret CRON_SECRET must equal vault secret cockpit_sync_secret; IP_SALT salts the join-page IP hash.
cutover_findings.breaks: Rotating one side (the cutover already reworked the management secret namespace, COCKPIT_MANAGEMENT_TOKEN) without the other stops the minute sweep reaching sales-live. Resetting IP_SALT changes every stored IP hash.

cutover_findings.finding: mahara-sales-rooms-sweep failed 8 and mahara-sales-watchdog 3 of their runs in the last 24 h, all 'canceling statement due to lock timeout' reading cockpit_sales_settings (2026-10-06 23:14 to 2026-10-07 03:25 and 12:57, +03).
cutover_findings.breaks: SQL that locks cockpit_sales_settings makes those minutes fail; both recover on the next run, and the watchdog may alert.

cutover_findings.finding: The rooms read cockpit_sales_appointments, cockpit_sales_leads and cockpit_sales_people, fed by the Supabase cron jobs mahara-sales-mirror (*/3) and mahara-ghl-appointments (20 * * * *).
cutover_findings.breaks: Retiring 'legacy writers' must mean Convex only; unscheduling these Supabase jobs would leave the rooms on stale appointments.

team_hours.note: Hours, leave and pay (branch team-hours, design 2026-10-09). Added after the 2026-10-07 inventory. state pending_deploy: absent objects are reported ok as not deployed yet. After the lead session applies 20261009a, deploys both functions and applies 20261009b, set state to deployed: from then on a missing object is MISSING, and a JWT check, row security or grant that drifts is CHANGED.
